scope: s 7 (the contribution duty), s 15(1)-(6) (withdrawal), s 16 (the medisave restrictions) and s 25(1) (who may nominate, and how a large nomination is split), with the s 2 definition of 'applicable person'. STILL A SMALL FRACTION of an Act of about 911,000 characters. ADDED 11 Oct 2026 for REQ-0001 and REQ-0012: First Schedule paragraphs 1 and 7 (contribution rates from 1 January 2026 for citizens and second-year-plus permanent residents, ordinary wages only, the Ordinary Wage Ceiling and rounding), s 24(3A) (moneys on death outside the estate) and s 25(5) (nomination revoked by marriage). ADDED 11 Oct 2026 for REQ-0002 and REQ-0003: s 13(4) crediting into the accounts, from the CPF Board's published allocation ratios from 1 January 2026 (the Minister's direction is not legislation; not deposited); and the Central Provident Fund (Exemption) Order 2018 (S 61/2018), paras 2 and 3 and the Schedule, IN THE VERSION AS MADE (in force 1 Jan to 1 Feb 2018), deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/CPFA1953-S61-2018.txt. NOT ENCODED: additional wages, the graduated permanent-resident rates, s 15AA, s 15(4), the housing and investment charges, the rest of s 25 and s 25A, and everything from Part 3A onwards. The prescribed retirement sum, the contribution rates and the Minister's maximum nomination amount are facts supplied; the regulations were not retrieved. ADDED 11 Oct 2026 for REQ-0268: s 9A (contributions by self-employed persons) with the s 9A(3) definition of 'income', s 8A(9) and Fourth Schedule paras 4-5 (platform remuneration leaving s 9A; Group A workers), s 9(2)-(3) interest, s 9C waiver, s 13(4)(b) and s 13A crediting and licence conditions, and s 58(1)(e), s 61(1), s 61B(1) and s 63(1) on non-payment. The Act fixes no rate, income floor, cap, payment period or interest rate for s 9A, and does not define 'self-employed person': all are prescribed by regulations under s 77(1) that the Act does not name and that were not retrieved, so they are inputs. ADDED 12 Oct 2026 for REQ-0268: the Central Provident Fund (Self-Employed Persons) Regulations 1992 (Rg 25), version in force from 1 January 2026, deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/CPFA1953-RG25.txt: regs 2(1) ('self-employed person', 'income'), 2A (platform remuneration from 1 January 2025), 3(1) (income over $6,000), 4(1)(m) and First Schedule item 23 (rates by age and income band from 2026), 7A(2)-(4A) (30 days after the contributions notice; instalments; less APE), 8, 8A, 9A and the Third Schedule, 13, 14 and 16; the s 9(2) interest rate is not in Rg 25 and remains an input. ADDED 12 Oct 2026 for REQ-0265: the CURRENT Central Provident Fund (Exemption) Order 2018 (2025 Revised Edition, version in force from 1 June 2026), paras 2, 3, 3A, 4 and 5 and the Schedule as renumbered (students now paras 6 to 9), deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/CPFA1953-OR10.txt, in cpf-exemption-current.l4; the version in force in May 2025 was not obtainable and is not encoded.
